limitations_reported: This was a local synthetic demo using only Python standard-library verification; no external-service, integration, or production checks were run.
Missing input was interpreted as an omitted argument or None, and both were tested.
Whitespace is determined by Python str.strip(); characters Python does not classify as whitespace are not rejected merely because they may be visually blank.
The fixture supplied no explicit upstream version or external evidence link, and no Git commit was created for the temporary implementation.
The Demo reviewer was named accountable owner, but no acceptance decision by that owner was observed.
